narrative.Summary: Initialize the openclaw-voice-sdk repository with the full toolchain: pnpm workspace, TypeScript 6, tsdown build, vitest test framework, oxlint linter, Taskfile. Includes package.json for @openclaw/voice-sdk, tsconfig.json, tsdown.config.ts, vitest.config.ts, oxlint.json, Taskfile.yml with check/test/build/lint/fmt/release tasks, .gitignore, CHANGELOG.md, and README stub. This scope has no source code — it is the foundation all subsequent scopes depend on.
narrative.Traces: NFR-2 (Node.js 22+), NFR-3 (ESM-only tsdown), NFR-5 (Conventional Commits), NFR-6 (npm publish config)
narrative.Acceptance: task check runs without error on an empty src/index.ts. task build produces dist/index.js and dist/index.d.ts. package.json exports map is correct. README contains a 'voice in the telecom sense' note explaining the name covers voice/video/screen/data.
narrative.Dependencies: None — this is the root scope.

items.title: Initialize git repo and pnpm workspace
items.narrative: git init, pnpm init, set packageManager field, add .npmrc with shamefully-hoist=false, add .gitignore.

items.title: Configure package.json for @openclaw/voice-sdk
items.narrative: name: @openclaw/voice-sdk, version: 0.1.0, type: module, engines: node>=22, exports map for ./index and ./providers/whatsapp and ./providers/mock entry points. files: [dist/]. bin entry for cli harness.

items.title: TypeScript configuration
items.narrative: tsconfig.json: target ES2023, module NodeNext, moduleResolution NodeNext, strict true, lib [ES2023]. tsconfig.build.json extends base, excludes test/. No DOM lib (NFR-2).

items.title: Build toolchain: tsdown
items.narrative: tsdown.config.ts: ESM output to dist/, sourcemaps, dts generation. Entry: src/index.ts, cli/index.ts. Mirror openclaw's tsdown patterns.

items.title: Test framework: vitest
items.narrative: vitest.config.ts: globals false, coverage via @vitest/coverage-v8 targeting >=85% (NFR-1), test pattern test/**/*.test.ts.

items.title: Linting: oxlint
items.narrative: oxlint.json mirroring openclaw config. Add oxfmt for formatting.

items.title: Taskfile.yml with core tasks
items.narrative: Tasks: default (task --list), build (tsdown), test (vitest run), lint (oxlint), fmt (oxfmt), check (deps: lint, build, test), release (npm publish --dry-run gate). Include deft tasks via optional include of ./directive/Taskfile.yml.

items.title: Stub src/index.ts and README.md
items.narrative: Empty barrel export. README with project name, one-liner description, 'voice in the telecom sense' note, and install instructions placeholder.
